transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Hello! I'm Dora, and I've just completed your post-cataract surgery follow-up check. 

Do you have any questions about your surgery or your recovery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Hi Dora! Yes, I have a few questions. First off, I'm curious about when I can start doing a little bit of gardening?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Great question! You can start doing light gardening about 1 week after your surgery. Just avoid any heavy lifting or strenuous work for the first month.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thank you! Yes, I do. When can I start using my eye gel for dry eyes again?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Good news – it's safe to continue using your eye gel for dry eyes. If you were using it before your surgery, you can keep using it unless you've been told otherwise by your doctor.

If you're running low, your GP should be able to provide more for you.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: I do, thanks! I'm very sensitive to bright light right now. Is that normal?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
Yes, it's quite normal for your eyes to be a bit sensitive to light as they adjust to your new lenses. If it's mild and things just seem brighter than you're used to, I'd recommend wearing sunglasses when you're outside.

However, if you have significant pain in bright light, or your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to check that further.

Do you have any other questions?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Thanks for explaining that. I have one more question: should I still have some blurriness by now?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
That depends on how long it's been since your surgery. It's quite common for vision to not be completely clear in the first week after your operation, but it should improve quickly and settle down over time.

If your vision is still blurry or getting significantly worse, we may need to check it to make sure everything's okay.

How long ago was your surgery?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: It's been about a week since my surgery. It helps to know it's normal to have some blurriness still. Thank you for answering my questions. I don't have any more right now!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Brilliant! So just to confirm – have all your questions been answered today?

transcript.speaker: patient
transcript.text: Yes, you've answered all my questions. Thanks so much for your help!

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're very welcome! Take care, and best of luck with your recovery.

verdict.label: pass

Finally, `escalation_criteria` was addressed by, "However, if you have significant pain in bright light, or your eye is also red and painful, that's not normal and we may need to check that further." All points were covered in a single turn.
